families.name: FUSE (900, 902, 904)
families.paradigm: Framework for Understanding Structural Errors (Modular Conceptual Hydrology)
families.description: Framework for Understanding Structural Errors (FUSE; Clark et al., 2008) modular conceptual hydrology suite combining process components from PRMS, SAC-SMA, TOPMODEL, and ARNO/VIC with a degree-day snow module (naddor/fuse), calibrated independently per basin via SCE-UA on Maurer forcings over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across three structural configurations (900, 902, 904; Addor et al., 2017; Kratzert et al., 2019b HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 501 (FUSE 900, 904) or 479 (FUSE 902) of 531 CAMELS basins available in the archive.

families.name: VIC 4.1.2 (CONUS MPR)
families.paradigm: Distributed Land-Surface Hydrology Model (CONUS Multiscale Parameter Regionalization)
families.description: Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC 4.1.2) macroscale land-surface hydrology model parameterized across CONUS via Multiscale Parameter Regionalization (MPR-flex; 16 global transfer-function coefficients calibrated via SCE-UA over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999; Mizukami et al., 2017; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).

families.name: SAC-SMA + Snow-17 (Basin-Calibrated)
families.paradigm: Lumped Conceptual Soil Moisture Accounting + Snow-17 Model (Basin SCE-UA Calibration)
families.description: Operational US National Weather Service Sacramento Soil Moisture Accounting (SAC-SMA) model coupled with the Snow-17 snow accumulation/ablation model and a Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph (Burnash et al., 1973; Anderson, 1973), calibrated independently per basin across 10 SCE-UA/DDS trials over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Newman et al., 2017; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 530 of 531 CAMELS basins (1 basin, USGS 01634500, is all-zero in the Newman et al., 2017 archive).

families.name: VIC 4.1.2 (Basin-Calibrated)
families.paradigm: Distributed Land-Surface Hydrology Model (Basin SCE-UA Calibration)
families.description: Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC 4.1.2) macroscale land-surface hydrology model calibrated independently per basin using Shuffled Complex Evolution (SCE-UA) over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Newman et al., 2017; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 530 of 531 CAMELS basins (1 basin, USGS 08082700, is missing in the Newman et al., 2017 archive).

families.name: HBV-light (HBV-upper & HBV-lower)
families.paradigm: Conceptual Lumped Rainfall-Runoff Model (100-Member Calibrated Ensemble & 1000-Member Uncalibrated Random Ensemble)
families.description: Conceptual semi-distributed/lumped HBV-light rainfall-runoff model (Seibert & Vis, 2012) providing dual upper and lower reference benchmarks on all 531 CAMELS-US basins forced by Maurer meteorology (Seibert et al., 2018; executed by Jan Seibert and Marc Vis for Kratzert et al., 2019b; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1): HBV-upper (gauged__single_camels) is the 100-member genetically calibrated GAP ensemble upper benchmark over WY2000–2008, and HBV-lower (pub__single_camels) is the 1000-member uncalibrated random-parameter ensemble lower benchmark sampled uniformly from physically plausible parameter bounds (using zero target or donor streamflow observations, NOT a donor-transfer calibration).

families.name: LSTM (12-Fold PUB)*
families.paradigm: Regional Long Short-Term Memory Network (12-Fold PUB)
families.description: Regional single-layer 256-unit Long Short-Term Memory network (CudaLSTM, 270-day lookback window) receiving daily extended NLDAS-2 meteorological forcings concatenated with 27 static CAMELS catchment attributes, trained with basin-averaged NSE* loss across 12 spatial k-fold cross-validation splits (PUB, 10 seeds per fold) over WY1981–1995 (1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30) and evaluated over WY1996–2010 (1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019a, WRR, Table 2; HydroShare 10.4211/hs.0a68bfd7ddf642a8be9041d60f40868c).
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated in Kratzert et al. (2019a) on Split-3 (trained on WY1981–1995, evaluated on WY1996–2010; 1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30) with extended NLDAS-2 forcing.

families.name: LSTM (Maurer 270d, 8-Seed Archive)
families.paradigm: Regional Long Short-Term Memory Network (270-day lookback)
families.description: Regional single-layer 256-unit Long Short-Term Memory network (CudaLSTM) with 270-day lookback window receiving daily Maurer meteorological forcings concatenated with 27 static CAMELS catchment attributes at every timestep, trained with basin-variance-normalized NSE* loss across 8 random seeds over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 on all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019b; HydroShare 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3530884).

families.name: Entity-Aware LSTM (EA-LSTM)
families.paradigm: Entity-Aware LSTM (Static-Attribute Input Gate)
families.description: Entity-Aware Long Short-Term Memory network (EA-LSTM; H = 256 memory cells, T = 270-day sequence length, dropout = 0.4, basin-averaged NSE* loss) in which the 27 static CAMELS catchment attributes exclusively modulate a time-invariant sigmoid input gate i = sigma(W_i x_s + b_i) while the 5 dynamic extended Maurer meteorological forcings drive the forget, cell-candidate, and output gates across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019b; Zenodo code archive 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; HydroShare hydrograph archive 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06).

families.name: LSTM without Static Attributes
families.paradigm: Regional LSTM without Catchment Attributes
families.description: Regional single-layer Long Short-Term Memory network (H = 256 memory cells, T = 270-day sequence length, dropout = 0.4, basin-averaged NSE* loss) trained jointly across all 531 CAMELS-US basins using only the 5 dynamic extended Maurer meteorological forcings without any static catchment attributes (D_static = 0 input-ablation baseline from Kratzert et al., 2019b; Zenodo code archive 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; HydroShare hydrograph archive 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06).

families.name: mHM (Basin-Calibrated)
families.paradigm: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (Basin Calibration)
families.description: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (mHM; Samaniego et al., 2010) at 0.25° grid resolution forced by daily 1/8° Maurer meteorology and calibrated independently per basin via Dynamically Dimensioned Search (DDS) on MPR transfer-function parameters over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Mizukami et al., 2019; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 492 of 531 CAMELS basins (39 basins missing in archive).

families.name: mHM (CONUS MPR)
families.paradigm: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (CONUS Multiscale Parameter Regionalization)
families.description: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (mHM; Samaniego et al., 2010) at 0.25° grid resolution forced by daily 1/8° Maurer meteorology and parameterized simultaneously across CONUS via Multiscale Parameter Regionalization (MPR; 48 global transfer-function parameters calibrated via DDS over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999; Rakovec et al., 2019; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 492 of 531 CAMELS basins (39 basins missing in archive).

families.name: Data-Integration LSTM (DI(1)-LSTM — MIP Re-run)
families.paradigm: Data-Integration LSTM with 1-Day Lagged Streamflow Q(t-1)
families.description: Clean-room PyTorch re-implementation of the Feng et al. (2020) 256-unit Data-Integration LSTM (DI(1)-LSTM) ingesting daily meteorological forcings, standardized 1-day lagged target-basin observed specific discharge Q(t-1) with binary validity indicator, and 27 static catchment attributes, trained with basin-variance-weighted NSE* loss over 365-day sequences across 6 random seeds on the canonical 531-basin Newman Split-1 Gauged protocol (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 training, 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 evaluation).

families.name: Data-Integration LSTM (DI(1)-LSTM — Literature)*
families.paradigm: Data-Integration LSTM with 1-Day Lagged Streamflow Q(t-1)
families.description: Regional 256-unit Long Short-Term Memory network with 1-day lagged observed specific discharge Q(t-1) data integration (DI(1)-LSTM; Feng et al., 2020, mhpi/hydroDL), trained on 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated on WY1991–1999 (9 water years; 1989–1990 used as 365-day spin-up buffer) across the 531 Newman CAMELS-US basins with Daymet forcing as reported by Jamaat et al. (2025, Table 1).
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on WY1991–1999 (9 water years; 1989–1990 used as spin-up) as reported by Jamaat et al. (2025) for the Feng et al. (2020) DI(1)-LSTM benchmark.

families.name: SAC-SMA + Snow-17 (DDS & Donor Transfer)
families.paradigm: Conceptual Soil Moisture Accounting + Snow-17 Model (DDS & 29-D Donor Transfer)
families.description: Clean-room C++17/OpenMP and Python re-implementation of coupled Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + 15-day Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph (27 calibrated parameters) calibrated per basin using Dynamically Dimensioned Search (DDS; Tolson & Shoemaker, 2007) over WY2000–2008 (Nearing et al., 2020), and extended to ungauged 12-fold PUB and 18-fold HUC-02 PUR prediction via k=1 nearest-neighbor donor parameter transfer in a 29-dimensional joint geographic and standardized static catchment-attribute space.

families.name: Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (XGBoost — Literature)
families.paradigm: Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees on Lagged Forcings (XGBoost)
families.description: Regional Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost; Chen & Guestrin, 2016) regression tree ensemble trained on 30 days of raw daily meteorological lag features (5 forcings x 30 lags = 150 dynamic features + 27 static catchment attributes = 177 input features) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins on Extended Maurer forcings over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Gauch, Mai, & Lin, 2021b, Environmental Modelling & Software 135, 104926; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3648270).

families.name: Mass-Conserving LSTM (MC-LSTM — MIP Re-run)
families.paradigm: Mass-Conserving Recurrent Neural Network (MC-LSTM)
families.description: Clean-room PyTorch + Triton fused recurrent scan implementation of Hoedt et al. (2021) MC-LSTM (64 mass cells, column-stochastic redistribution matrix, 1 trash sink cell + 63 summed discharge cells, sequence length 365, NSE* loss). Includes single-forcing models and a 3-forcing multi-input configuration (arithmetic mean precipitation mass input with all 15 meteorological drivers + 27 static attributes in the auxiliary gate vector).

families.name: Mass-Conserving LSTM (MC-LSTM — Literature)*
families.paradigm: Mass-Conserving Recurrent Neural Network (MC-LSTM)
families.description: Mass-conserving LSTM where recurrent cell states act as non-negative water buckets updated via a column-stochastic redistribution matrix R[t], softmax input gate distributing unnormalized precipitation mass, sigmoid output gate, 64 hidden cells (1 trash cell for ET/percolation sink + 63 summed discharge readout cells), and z-scored auxiliary meteorological + 27 static catchment attributes.
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated in Hoedt et al. (2021) on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. (2019b) CAMELS subset.

families.name: LSTM (Single- & Multi-Forcing 365d Archive)
families.paradigm: Regional Single- & Multi-Forcing Long Short-Term Memory Network
families.description: Author-archived 10-seed single-forcing (Daymet, Maurer, NLDAS) and multi-forcing (Daymet+Maurer+NLDAS, Daymet+Maurer, Daymet+NLDAS, Maurer+NLDAS) 256-unit CudaLSTM models with 365-day lookback window and 27 static CAMELS attributes, trained with NSE* loss over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2021; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4670268).

families.name: LSTM (PUB & PUR MIP Re-run)
families.paradigm: Regional Single- & Multi-Forcing Long Short-Term Memory Network
families.description: Clean-room PyTorch re-implementation (models/kratzert_lstm) of the Kratzert et al. (2021) 256-unit, 365-day lookback regional CudaLSTM with 27 static catchment attributes and basin-normalized NSE* loss, trained over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins under the canonical 12-fold PUB and 18-fold HUC-02 Leave-One-Region-Out PUR spatial cross-validation protocols.

families.name: dPL + VIC (g_A, Maurer)*
families.paradigm: Differentiable Parameter Learning with Neural Surrogate VIC
families.description: Differentiable Parameter Learning (dPL) using a static-attribute neural parameter network (g_A, trained via an iteratively refined 4-round LSTM runoff surrogate) to infer 8 basin-specific soil/infiltration parameters for the C-language Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC 4.1.2) land-surface model and 2 Gamma unit-hydrograph routing parameters, evaluated with the physical C-language VIC 4.1.2 model over WY1990–1999.
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 498 of 531 CAMELS basins available in the Tsai et al. (2021) Figure 6a archive (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6383415; g_Z variant achieves 0.435 median NSE on 499 basins).

families.name: δHBV 1.0
families.paradigm: Dynamic-Parameter LSTM + 16-Bucket Differentiable HBV
families.description: Differentiable process-based HBV 1.0 model coupling a regional 256-unit cuDNN LSTM parameter network with 16 parallel sub-basin conceptual HBV rainfall-runoff buckets (dynamic daily soil-moisture nonlinearity BETA and evapotranspiration exponent BETAET alongside 11 static bucket parameters) and a shared 15-day Gamma unit hydrograph routing kernel, trained end-to-end with combined linear/log-sqrt RMSE loss.

families.name: Autoregressive & Data-Assimilation LSTM (AR-LSTM, DA-LSTM)
families.paradigm: Autoregressive & Variational Data-Assimilation LSTM
families.description: Regional 256-unit LSTM networks ingesting 1-day-lagged observed streamflow Q(t-1) via scheduled-sampling autoregression with Bernoulli Markov observation holdout (AR-LSTM: no holdout and 0.5 holdout) or test-time 5-day sliding-window variational cell-state data assimilation (DA-LSTM) across 531 CAMELS-US basins forced by Daymet, Maurer, and NLDAS.

families.name: Rainfall-Runoff Transformer (RR-Former)
families.paradigm: Encoder-Decoder Transformer with Lagged Streamflow (RR-Former)
families.description: Encoder-decoder Transformer (RR-Former; d_model=64, 4 attention heads, num_encoder_layers=1, num_decoder_layers=1, dim_feedforward=256, 3-layer MLP head 64->32->16->1 with LeakyReLU) ingesting 7-day meteorological forcing sequences, 27 static catchment attributes, and 7-day lagged observed streamflow Q(t-7..t-1), trained via 300-epoch regional pretraining across all 531 CAMELS-US basins followed by 40-epoch per-basin fine-tuning at lr=1e-4 with early stopping (Yin et al., 2022; iThronne/RR-Former).

families.name: Mass-Conserving LSTM (MC-LSTM — Frame 2023 Archive)
families.paradigm: Mass-Conserving Recurrent Neural Network (MC-LSTM)
families.description: 8-seed ensemble of Hoedt et al. (2021) Mass-Conserving LSTM trained on single-forcing Daymet and NLDAS meteorological inputs over the 531 CAMELS-US basins by Frame et al. (2023, Hydrological Processes).

families.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT)
families.paradigm: Attention-Recurrent Hybrid (Temporal Fusion Transformer)
families.description: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) with variable selection networks, LSTM encoder-decoder, and multi-head interpretable self-attention re-run under the CAMELS-US MIP protocol.

families.name: δHBV 1.1p / δMG
families.paradigm: LSTM + 16-Bucket Differentiable HBV (Dynamic Parameters)
families.description: 16-bucket differentiable HBV 1.1p (δMG) with capillary rise flux and time-varying (dynamic) soil-moisture recharge exponent β, near-surface recession coefficient K0, and ET shape parameter γ predicted daily by a 256-unit DropConnect LSTM with 15-day Gamma unit-hydrograph routing.

families.name: δHBV 1.1p Variational Data Assimilation (δHBV-DA-PS, -S, -P)*
families.paradigm: Differentiable HBV (δHBV 1.1p) with 5-Day Variational State & Precipitation Data Assimilation
families.description: 16-bucket differentiable HBV (δHBV 1.1p, with 3 dynamic time-varying parameters predicted by a 256-unit regional LSTM from 3 Daymet meteorological forcings and 35 static catchment attributes) coupled with training-free 5-day sliding-window variational data assimilation (Adadelta, 5 steps per window, NSELossBatch3 with monotonic acceptance gating) that updates initial hydrological log-states (SNOWPACK, MELTWATER, SM, SUZ, SLZ; δHBV-DA-S), last-day precipitation multiplier k^4 (δHBV-DA-P), or both jointly (δHBV-DA-PS) on the 531 Newman CAMELS-US basins.
families.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on WY1991–1999 (9 water years; 1989–1990 used as 365-day spin-up buffer in the background MHPI checkpoint) in Jamaat et al. (2025).

families.name: (LSTM + dHBV 1.1p) Multi-Model Ensemble
families.paradigm: Multi-Structure Hybrid Ensemble (Regional LSTM + Differentiable HBV 1.1p)
families.description: Multi-structure hybrid ensemble of Li, Song, Pan, Lawson, and Shen (2025, HESS 29, 6829-6861; DOI: 10.5194/hess-29-6829-2025; Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.16895228) combining multi-forcing regional LSTM predictions with differentiable HBV 1.1p (dMG) predictions. On Stage-1 Split-3 (WY1980-1995 train / WY1995-2008 test, 531 basins), the 60-member multi-forcing hybrid ensemble (LSTM + dHBV)_seed^123 achieves Med NSE = 0.8225 (published 0.823; independent StandaloneDHBV Split-3 re-run hybrid = 0.8195), the single-seed 6-member multi-forcing hybrid (LSTM + dHBV)^123 achieves Med NSE = 0.8176 +/- 0.0040 (member[0] = 0.8184 vs published 0.818; re-run = 0.8165), and the Daymet single-seed hybrid (LSTM + dHBV)^1_Daymet achieves Med NSE = 0.7895 (member[0]; 10-seed mean 0.7871 +/- 0.0013 vs published 0.790; re-run = 0.7872). On Stage-2 Newman Split-1 (WY1999-2008 train / WY1989-1999 test, 531 basins, Daymet + Maurer + NLDAS), the equal-weight 2-component multi-structure ensemble (t4_06.zarr; member[0] = Kratzert et al. 2021 10-seed 3-forcing LSTM ensemble t4_05.zarr with Med NSE = 0.8210, member[1] = Song et al. 2024 5-seed 3-forcing dHBV 1.1p ensemble t4_24.zarr with Med NSE = 0.7992) achieves Med NSE = 0.8200 (0.820), matching the 20-member equal-seed ensemble t4_03.zarr (Med NSE = 0.8195 / 0.820). No separate single-model row is emitted for li2025_lstm_dhbv_ens because its individual constituent models (kratzert2021_lstm_archive and song_dhbv11p) are already evaluated as standalone entries on Table 4.

families.name: TSLib Deep Learning Suite (10 Models: Crossformer, PatchTST, Informer, etc.)
families.paradigm: General Time-Series Deep Learning Suite (Transformers, MLPs, Temporal 2D-Variation, CNNs)
families.description: Ten general-purpose time-series deep learning models adapted from the Time-Series-Library (TSLib) via the rainflow hydrology benchmark framework (9 Transformer variants: Crossformer, Non-stationary Transformer, Vanilla Transformer, Informer, Pyraformer, ETSformer, Reformer, iTransformer, and CARDformer; plus the moving-average linear decomposition model DLinear), trained simultaneously on Daymet, Maurer, and NLDAS forcings and 26 static catchment attributes across all 531 CAMELS-US basins over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Liu et al., 2025, Supplement Table S1; PatchTST and TimesNet were evaluated in the same study on autoregressive forecasting tasks).

families.name: Frequency-Tuned Diagonal State Space Model (S4D-FT & S4D)
families.paradigm: Diagonal & Frequency-Tuned Diagonal Structured State Space Model (S4D / S4D-FT)
families.description: Six-layer diagonal structured state-space sequence model (HOPE) evaluated without (S4D, cfr = cfi = 1) and with frequency-tuned HiPPO state-matrix initialization (S4D-FT, cfr = cfi = 10, scaling Re(A) = -0.5^cfr and Im(A_n) = pi * n * cfi without per-basin fine-tuning) over 365-day lookback windows on the canonical Newman et al. (2017) 531-basin CAMELS-US split with NLDAS forcings and 27 static catchment attributes (Wang, Zhang, et al., 2025a, Water Resources Research 61, e2025WR039888).

families.name: Static-Parameter MLP + 16-HBV (diff-hydro)
families.paradigm: Static MLP + 16-Zone Differentiable HBV
families.description: Regional 3-layer Multilayer Perceptron (2048 hidden units) mapping static catchment attributes to time-invariant parameters of a 16-component parallel differentiable HBV rainfall-runoff model with Gamma unit-hydrograph routing.

families.name: Mamba-3 Static-Dynamic Adapter
families.paradigm: Selective State Space Model (Mamba + Static-Dynamic Adapter)
families.description: Parameter- and depth-matched 2-layer selective state-space model (d_model=112, d_state=32, d_conv=4, expand=2, 320,641 parameters) coupled with zero-initialized post-block Static-Dynamic Adapters conditioning hidden representations on 27 CAMELS static catchment attributes over 365-day Daymet lookback sequences (Shahriar, 2026; SSRN 7552815, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23087719).

families.name: Empirical Research Assistant -- LSTM Seeded
families.paradigm: Machine learning
families.description: Autonomous hydrological architectures discovered by the Empirical Research Assistant (ERA) seeded from the Kratzert et al. (2021) regional multi-forcing LSTM baseline across Gauged, 12-Fold PUB, and 18-Fold HUC-02 PUR regimes under Unguided (minimal guidance), Physics-Guided, and Multi-Paradigm experimental protocols (Nearing, 2026).
